name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Durban Poison
description: Indulge in the sweet, doughy delight of Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Apple Fritter, a premium concentrate that captures the bold flavors and powerful effects of this legendary hybrid. Crafted from fresh-frozen cannabis, this terpene-rich extract delivers a smooth, full-bodied experience with every dab. With a sweet apple, cinnamon, and creamy pastry flavor profile, Apple Fritter offers a perfectly balanced high—elevating your mood with a euphoric cerebral buzz while melting stress away with deep, full-body relaxation. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or tap into creative inspiration, this potent live resin wax has got you covered.
